title: Japanese writer Keigo Higashino, author of 'The Devotion of Suspect X', dies at 68
summary: The novelist, winner of the Naoki Prize, died of colorectal cancer, leaving a literary legacy of great influence in Japanese mystery.

title: Japan's Prime Minister Takaichi holds press conference after extraordinary Diet session ends
summary: Takaichi addressed the consumption tax reduction and economic measures in her appearance before the media.

title: Japan records temperatures above 40°C in Kyushu for first time this summer
summary: The town of Hita, in Oita, reached 40.0 degrees, marking the hottest day of the year in the western region.

title: Multiple high school baseball teams qualify for the summer Koshien tournament
summary: Representatives from various prefectures, including Kanto Daiichi, Ritsumeikan Uji, and Chiben Wakayama, secured their places in the national championship.

title: Osaka governor proposes collaboration agreement with city to promote designated capital
summary: Yoshimura seeks to establish a foundation for Osaka to become a secondary capital without waiting for municipal merger.

title: Japan's consumption tax reduction plan faces legislative hurdles
summary: The technical committee failed to reach consensus and the ruling party abandoned the bipartisan agreement, leaving the final decision to Prime Minister Takaichi.

title: Prime Minister Takaichi's cabinet approval ratings drop in polls
summary: Polls reveal a decline in public support due to parliamentary management and inflation, while Takaichi avoids analyzing the causes.

title: Self-Defense Forces member indicted for trespassing at Chinese embassy in Tokyo
summary: The uniformed member faces charges of property invasion and threats after remaining hidden in the diplomatic facilities.

title: Bribery scandal in Fukuoka prefectural assembly implicates former vice-presidents and a resigning lawmaker
summary: Testimonies and voice recordings reveal million-dollar payments to access political positions in the prefecture.

title: Court confirms police illegality in Matsuhashi case and orders state compensation
summary: The appeals ruling recognizes that both the prosecution and police acted illegally in the arrest that led to a wrongful conviction.

title: Multiple-vehicle accident on Oita expressway leaves more than ten injured
summary: Five vehicles, including a tour bus, collided on the Oita expressway, injuring the occupants.
